title: Canada and Europe want to work closer together – level 1
paragraphs: Canada and Europe want to work closer together. Many people in Canada prefer to buy things from Europe instead of the United States. Trade with the United States is changing.

European leaders are talking about how to help each other more. They want to share energy, keep prices low, and help students study in different countries. Some big countries in Europe say that the rules are not ready for a special membership. But they still want to be strong friends.
Working together helps both Canada and Europe stay safe, protect their businesses, and keep their people happy.

words.d: to give a part of something to others, or to use something together
when a country or person belongs to a group, club, or organization
to keep someone or something safe
